evidenceNotes.observation: The pinned diff 2228daff027113a10790c75f2901c0b804d60a25..dcd38348e5a74e250a6dbfa22e743fc7da0964ff is byte-identical to the 4,761-byte stored artifact (SHA-256 4313dd3d4567eb8c83fc64cbc2e0065de149a6680f06f3b052908ad00d610921); merge base, trees 6fc6ac847bc62e49f5f2ab9f7774b1f234b75267 and 70f9720cdb1e9641bc5e87a2a80822b9c20dc9d7, and 3-file +101/-1 stats match.

The introduced logical optimizer folds a branch whenever evaluateExpression(left).asBool() is boolean. Existing APIPlugin registers evaluateTypeof for every replacement key, including __non_webpack_require__, although REPLACEMENT_TYPES has no entry for it, making the runtime-sensitive guard falsely eligible for compile-time folding.

The authenticated issue reports 4.21.0 working and 4.22.0 reducing typeof __non_webpack_require__ !== 'undefined' to true. The repair gates evaluateTypeof registration on a known type and adds a test that toggles runtime require, directly validating causal consequence and the smallest repair boundary.

The MIT case confines the claim to the interaction of logical folding with the missing static type for a runtime-sensitive alias. It discloses that the linked PDF.js reproduction was not archived or rerun and does not claim all logical folding is defective.
